budget_basis: pre-freeze complete high-stress integration profile ~62 seconds; original proposal budgets were provisional; per-case caps unchanged
compounding_definition: C=depth3>=.01 AND depth3+retainedexpansion>=.01; funded C additionally external-spent lowerbound>=.8 and all thermal-forward birth share<=.05
decomposition: packet,bank,D,A,B,C next-state chain rule given full past physical state; T256 at dt.25
error_allowance: T/dt*PoissonResidual + .5*T^2*harmonicResidual + 1e-7; solver allowance, not a formal interval proof

followups.matched_work_companion: stationary accepted external work only; does not match activity, total bath import or finite cumulative work
followups.single_type_comparator: matched catalytic strength; network robustness advantage not assumed
followups.source_window_queries: closure time, twice and four times lifetime, with actual post-closure dynamics
followups.spatial_same_law_replication: positions/local fuel/contact, all native agitation, naturally assembling references, memory gate
followups.whole_type_knockout: remove all B into usable precursor; separate from primary one-B pulse

funding_diagnostic.gross_capture: may include initially stored, bath-return and reverse-capture packets
funding_diagnostic.zero_source_control: external funding must remain zero even with capture/recycling

joint_definition: J requires funded C,R,and strict positive T256 difference across all cadences; strong J adds depthby64+loop64+expanded256+no closure>=.01

markers.interpretation: reporting benchmarks, not reward terms or eligibility filters

measurement.grain_scope: chemical count-state grain; spatial gas claim requires Stage C
measurement.reducible_analysis: class/projection and residual background; no irreducible shortcut

physical_profiles: stocks, flows, uptime and activity at all five horizons; first arrival at16/64/256

predictions.P1: some shape setting C and full retained-expansion probability exceeds each of three individual link cuts at T256
predictions.P3: at fixed anchors irreversible damage raises closure and lowers recovery: compare R1/R3/R6 closure and R4/R5 joint recovery
predictions.P4: at least one pulse anchor full improves joint prefunction+endpoint restoration over C-to-A cut at delay64
predictions.P5: some full setting funded C/R and positive seed-minus-thermal at T256 at every cadence; unbound scored separately
predictions.P6: some full setting funded C/R and positive full-minus-alloff AND full-minus-C-to-A-cut at T256 at every cadence
predictions.P7a: per fixed anchor, Spearman association across seven stresses is positive between tau_up and full-minus-alloff and seed-minus-unbound T256 differences; descriptive, not a theorem
predictions.P7b: not run: separate opportunity-window freeze required

pulse_convention: T64 score/occupancy just before deterministic pulse; all later scores include prefix and post-pulse history
reference_rule: same H7, D0; conditional known-root average, no root-draw entropy
robustness_definition: R=post-startup loop uptime>=.5 and closure<=.1; actual pulse arms also require conditional recovery>=.8 and joint prefunction/recovery>=.5 at delay64
scope: coarse three-type chemistry; not spatial gas, valuers, open-ended growth or an ethical verdict
sign_rule: delta>bits_tolerance+both numerical residual allowances; no cadence selecting or activity subtraction
undefined_recovery: no actual pulse: recovery clause not applicable, not counted as a recovery pass
